content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sierra Vista

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. PMI sets specific thresholds for both; review the official requirements to confirm you meet them before enrolling. Granite PM Academy staff can answer eligibility questions during a brief consultation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® preparation course. Attend sessions from anywhere—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® Guide, real-world case studies, and exam domains. You'll earn the 35 contact hours PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the course, apply directly to PMI through their candidate portal. Submit your project-experience documentation, education credentials, and exam fee. PMI reviews and approves applications before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam through Pearson Vue at a testing center convenient to you. The PMP® exam assesses your mastery of project-management principles and processes.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, presenting, publishing, or serving PMI. Renew your certification before expiration to stay current and advance your career in Sierra Vista's defense, government, and healthcare sectors.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
